notes.title: Free Content Update "Frenzy" Available Now!
notes.content:
Savara is getting its first free content update; read about it and take a look here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/fa73e16e5439bfec8dffa325d9d8903233b09871.png

This update ushers in a new weapon and a new category of blessings for even more variety in battle.
 
New Weapons to Destroy Them All: Spears

If you haven't yet found your perfect weapon, we have news that should delight warriors searching for mobility! With spears, discover a new way of fighting and their unique and divinely efficient tactics against opponents.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/4833a79e07f9bab49ce536aae17ad1ea2bafec0b.gif
 
Aim with precision and break different parts of the monsters standing in your way. Exploit their weaknesses and do even more damage by hitting 'em where it hurts!
 
How to Equip and Use a Spear

To equip a spear in one of Savara's weapon slots, simply head to the blacksmith.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/7f0c36e1360e3ff6e980677c22659d483f90fc6b.jpg
There, you can examine your new favorite weapons – their specific details, variants, and looks!
 
A Collector's Skin for Even More Style

A little extra bonus has slipped into the "Legacy of the Heavens" collector's edition of Savara. It would be a shame to head into battle with a new weapon that didn't go with the rest of your outfit. Owners of the collector's edition can get this gift from Iop for free and give their spear a brand-new appearance.
 
New Category of Blessings Available: Frenzy
 
Hit fast to hit harder to hit even FASTER! When Frenzy takes hold of Savara, nothing can stop her!
This new category of blessing introduces a full 30 variants to wake your inner Iop.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/67ae93b9b0c7f16e3cd51ee838a378db4c0c1ca6.jpg
 
With Frenzy, kick up your gameplay a notch and make your battles even more epic and intense than they already were.
 
Check Out This Free Update Now!
What? Why are you still here? Jump into the fray!

notes.title: Help Us Get the Word Out About Savara!
notes.content:
Disciples of Iop,

It's been a week since Savara was released, and we want to send all of you who have already played the game and shared your feedback our warmest thanks!


We hope that you're enjoying the trials and battles along your path to glory. If you are, you can help us out a lot by leaving a review on Steam.

Indeed, Iop isn't the only one in charge when it comes to sharing feats. Your ratings play a key role in the visibility of a game on the platform: the more positive reviews a game gets, the greater its chances of being promoted by Steam's algorithm.


We'd be delighted to read all about your adventures!
In just a few seconds, you can have a real impact on an independent studio like ours.

notes.title: Savara Joins the Games Made In France Festival
notes.content:
After kicking off the tournament with a bang, it’s time for Savara — well, its dev team — to step into the spotlight with some live interviews during the Games Made In France online festival.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/dec71134cb9e3238b2b3f5bff6fcfb81fb9157e9.jpg

Back to the Roots for Savara and the Dev Team
After making waves at PAX East earlier this month, we’re now reconnecting with our French-speaking community for a little catch-up session.

Join part of the development team live on May 15 at 8:00 PM (Paris time) on MisterMV’s Twitch channel, alongside Shisheyu, as they chat about our newly launched action-roguelite, Savara.

Talking’s Great, but Fighting’s Better!
With controllers in hand, the team will take you on some live runs through the halls of Iop’s palace — the perfect way to break the ice (and a few monsters) while sharing behind-the-scenes insights on the game.

📅 Don’t miss it: May 15 at 8:00 PM (Paris time)

notes.title: Savara : Patchnote 0.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/e97cbaeba46ce8ca08a7146ecb62c3825c037eac.png

General

 The game and interfaces have been adjusted to be clearer on more platforms, including Steam Deck.
 The game now has voiceover in English or French.
 An intro animatic starts when a new save is created.
 The Hub and its environment have been overhauled.
 NPCs have been added to the Hub.


Savara

 An armor system has been added; armor can be crafted using parts of defeated monsters. Armor accessible in the demo:

 Savara: increases attack damage.
 Rhinobuto: reduces damage suffered and increases max health.
 Puginoko: increases max health after you complete a room.


 New weapon: Longsword.

 This long-range weapon is based on perfect timings. The more successful your timings are, the harder and faster you'll strike.


 Shield & Sword rework:

 Charged attack: Savara throws her shield to inflict increasing damage after each hit.
 Weapon swap: Savara delivers a shield blow and is invulnerable for the duration of the attack.
 Ultimate attack: blocks all attacks for a short time. If at least one attack has been stopped, Savara performs a powerful whirlwind attack. Successfully blocking at just the right moment will increase the whirlwind attack's damage and fully recharge the ultimate gauge.

 Heavy Blade improvement:

 When you use the third attack in a combo, the charged attack or ultimate attack, you now apply the Weakening effect on any enemies hit.
 Weakening: increases damage suffered by the target.

 Dual Blade improvement:

 Combo attack: The more attacks you land, the faster they are and more damage they do.

 New weapon variants added: Puginoko

 Modified endurance system: As long as you have at least 1 endurance point, you can perform an attack even if it costs more.

 Dodge roll: The period of invulnerability on performing a dodge roll has increased slightly.

 Attack direction: increased the speed of rotation to change attack angles.

 Weapon swap: cooldown reduced to allow for smoother combos.

 Improvement to effective damage: Using the right weapon type (Bludgeoning/Slashing/Piercing) on a monster part with weakness against it will inflict more damage than before.


Enemies
 The puginoko no longer inflicts damage in front of it when it leaps.

 New boss added: Mature Puginoko
 New elite added: Bombardier Rhinobuto
 Poultragon family added; only available in the standard version for the demo

 New enemy type added: Lackeys.

 These monsters are pretty weak, but be careful they don't wear you down during your attempts.
 New lackeys added: Inudogo.
 New lackeys added: Inudawa.
 New lackeys added: Henkiv.
 New lackeys added: Henker.
 New lackeys added: Henkam.


Blessing 
 New blessing family added: Judgment

 Creates an area of effect that inflicts damage as a percentage of affected enemies' health.

 New blessing family added: Devotion

 Spawns orbs that can be collected to increase damage on the next string of attacks.

 Change to Aftershock: also inflicts damage based on the target's missing health.
 Change to Electrified: The lightning bolts' damage is increased by the damage from the attack that caused the lightning bolt.
 Change to Bleeding: The number of stacks applied depends on the damage inflicted by the applying attack. When an enemy has 20 stacks or more on them, they suffer extra damage.
 Change to Armor: This stacks more quickly but cannot exceed 20% of Savara's max health.


Roguelite
 A resource merchant has been added to the Hub.

 Monster resources can be traded for honor.

 The 3rd statue level is now accessible.
 Bosses now give a unique badge the first time they're defeated.
 The Iop god statue now only requires honor to be improved.
 Talents from the Iop god statue now only require honor to be unlocked.
 New resource added: Radiant Bronze.

 This resource, which can be obtained from bosses or the merchant, will let you improve weapons at level 5.



Arenas 
 Walls and pillars in the arena can now be destroyed by bosses and elite monsters.
 Vases are now destructible with an attack or a dodge roll.

 Rooms will now have randomly placed traps.

 New trap added: Spike slab.
 New trap added: Gong.
 New trap added: Divine grape.
 New trap added: Spitfire.
 New trap added: Mud.



Interface
 Basic HUD: added areas to the HUD for viewing player upgrades.
 Monster health bar: added what states they have, as well as the duration and amount of stacks.
 "Magnifying glasses" have been added so you can see enemies and reward doors off screen.
 Basic tutorials have been reworked.
 Interface tutorials have been added.
 The Statue interface has been reworked.
 The Forge interface has been reworked.
 The Blessing interface has been reworked.
 New interface added: Equipment Overview.
 New interface added: Codex.
 New interface added: Resources.

notes.title: Savara: New Mechanics and Challenges for the Steam Fest Demo
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/e30d1b67668517381cfb47825c32ab17ac63e1da.png

Hey, Savara adventurers!

The Steam Fest demo is fast approaching! We've been working hard to offer an even more immersive and dynamic experience! This new version of the demo was shaped by your valuable feedback. We listened closely to your suggestions and tweaked a number of elements in order to give you the best gameplay experience. From updated game mechanics to added story elements, here are the latest changes coming to the demo for the upcoming Steam Next Fest.

1. Smoother Maneuverability

We went all out to improve how you control Savara and make each action more intuitive and fun.

- Redesigned endurance system:In the new version, as long as your endurance stays above 0, you can perform any of your actions (attacks, dodges, and abilities), giving you more freedom and fluidity in combat.

- Enhanced dodge roll: We've increased the duration of invulnerability during a dodge roll, so you'll have more room to dodge enemy attacks.

- Maneuverability during attacks: You will now have more control over your ability to quickly turn around while attacking, allowing you to chain attacks more smoothly and react to enemies' movements more quickly.

- Weapon swap: The time it takes to recover after swapping weapons has been reduced from 3 to 2 seconds, which lets you switch between weapons more often, for a more fluid combat experience.

2. Redesigned Weapons
Weapons are now unique and strategic, with features adapted to different play styles.

- New weapon: the longsword. What sets this weapon apart is its mechanic based on timing. By precisely chaining your attacks, you can increase the speed and power of your hits while conserving your endurance. This is a weapon for players who like a challenge.

- Reworked sword and shield: We've given this weapon category a stronger identity. The sword and shield now feature a Counter mechanic on the ultimate attack, which lets you counterattack after parrying an attack. Also, if you perform a Counter right before the attack hits you, the counterattack deals more damage and instantly refills the gauge for the ultimate!

- Great sword: Now whenever you use the third attack in a combo, the charged attack or ultimate attack, you apply the Weakening effect on any enemies hit. This effect increases damage suffered by monsters hit by this attack by 25% for 8 seconds.

- Dual blade: When you hit an enemy with your combo attacks, you gain the Frenzy effect. Thus, each combo increases the speed and damage of subsequent combos by 20%, up to 100%. Frenzy goes away when you stop chaining combo attacks. Focus on endurance gains to maximize them!

3. Redesigned Interfaces
The interfaces have been redesigned to offer a more intuitive experience.
Interface tutorials: We've added various tutorials to our interfaces in order to clarify how they work.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/4c07087830b959d2f535ccc1a5f9651c270e3bcb.png
 
Talent select UI: Now clearer and more intuitive, we wanted to emphasize unlocking talent slots and their connections to the various tiers on the statue.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/88aed512c5563f613e3e3c37afc0c2008d585178.png

Forge UI: reorganized to make it easier to navigate, and available enhancements easier to understand. We also made it possible to see effect stacking on your currently equipped weapons. 

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/2ef062f2a850359092bde8dbb2910d54f6ee4650.png

Equipment summary UI: This interface has been reworked to offer a more comprehensive, detailed recap of your equipment (weapons, armor, talents, and badges), along with the bonuses acquired during a run (blessings). You can now track every aspect of your character in real time to better plan out your strategies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/715b0971c2728d7d734d99195b9ed7ed3bee6eee.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/9114818c5bbada3f2d42858064257d4c892c6c5a.png

Blessing select UI: This interface has been improved to be more attractive and readable, which should help make your choices more strategic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/1cc988b92ddb78b2d5fd6fecaeff8d26ac18a265.png

4. New Blessings 
We've added exciting new blessings to add even more variety to your runs and to enhance your tactical choices.

Judgment: creates AOEs (areas of effect) that deal damage as a percentage equal to 10 + 0.2% of the HP of the monster in the AOE, per second. It's useful for dealing with multiple enemies.
 
- Devotion: spawns orbs that can be collected to increase damage on the next string of attacks. This strategic blessing will maximize your combos.

5. Improvements to Existing Blessings

- Aftershock: inflicts 140 damage -> 200 damage + 4% of the target's missing health. The aftershock now gains power over the course of the fight, against opponents with a lot of health.

- Electrified: inflicting damage on an electrified enemy causes a lightning bolt to strike, dealing 15 damage -> 8 damage + 10% of the attack's damage, allowing you to more effectively combine this blessing with other attack damage increase effects, as well as make the blessing more effective on slower weapons.

- Bleeding:  applies 1 stack per hit on an enemy -> applies stacking equal to a percentage of damage inflicted. Each stack inflicts 5 -> 1 damage per second. Also, when over 20 stacks are placed on a target, the target now suffers 30% extra damage when you attack it. Just like Electrified, this category used to be ineffective with slower weapons. This change should make it more viable, regardless of your weapon of choice.

- Armor: This blessing now stacks more quickly, but it is capped at 20% of the player's health, making it easier to use while preventing it from becoming too dominant.

6. Interactive Environments
Between good vibes and a gameplay element, we decided to make some in-game environments destructible.

- Pots : can be destroyed by the player or monsters: a must-have.

- Walls: These obstacles can only be destroyed by bosses and elite monsters, which will gradually impact your ability to take cover while fighting these fearsome opponents.

7. Traps and Bonuses in Each Room
There are new room mechanics offering challenges and bonuses.

- Healing orb: These orbs restore 20 HP, enabling you to survive the festival longer.

- Gong: This can be activated by attacks from the player or from monsters. When activated, it stuns all enemies in the room for a few seconds so you can get the upper hand.

- Spike trap: When the player goes over it, spikes come out of the ground and deal damage to self and to monsters.

- Fire-breathing statue: These statues spew flames one second after the player goes over them, inflicting damage to the player and to enemies.

8. New Monsters and a Second Boss 
To make each run more dynamic, we've added new monsters, along with variants of existing monsters. You'll have to contend with new behaviors and attacks, adding even more variety to every run you do.

We've also added a second boss at the end of the demo, with unique mechanics to put your skills to the test!

9. Create Your Own Armor
Armor is being introduced to Savara! You can now create new armor items in the forge menu, letting you customize your equipment even more in order to face whatever challenges may come.

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/0208fc59d2d10b5cb789a1357ec0426f4d0aaabe.png

10. Dialogue
Finally, we've added early dialogue to the game, with voiceover available in English and French. This dialogue will enrich the story and interactions with the characters, allowing for deeper immersion in the Savara universe. We worked with talented actors to offer high-quality voiceover, both in English and French.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/a76b02eaf01151c4efb88644c129030f2e07bf88.png
 
11. Enhancements to Effective Damage
Choose the right weapon for each monster. To encourage players to use the right weapon on the right part of the monster, we reevaluated effective damage. Here is what changed:

The increase ratios for effective damage are now 30 to 100% higher, depending on what part of the monster you attack. This will maximize damage by targeting enemies' weak spots and favoring a more tactical approach. We also made the different fonts for damage clearer based on context (white = ineffective weapon, yellow = effective weapon, red outline = broken part).

You can now see what parts of the monster are weak against what damage types in the Codex section of the game, so you'll be able to adapt your equipment to the weaknesses of enemies encountered, and even to ones you may want to aim for.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/0907fd47391c81d643e8733ef36818aa99150620.png

notes.title: Ankama Show Time: Join Us on December 18!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/0fb765701b5d1f101913cc144fb9ae90f64f05f1.jpg

Adiós, KrosmoNote…

 

KrosmoNote, after five wonderful years, it's time for us to part ways. We've shared some incredible moments together… Remember the very first time we celebrated 15 years of DOFUS? And now the game has just celebrated its 20th birthday. And do you remember when the world went into lockdown? Faithful to your post, you warmed our hearts, much more than this fake hearth.

 

We shared some difficult times and the best laughs as well. But it's time to move on. No, KrosmoNote, don't make this more difficult than it needs to be. Leave… And don't come back. No, it's not you, it's just that… We've found someone else, someone better!

 

Meet Ankama Show Time!

 

Ankama Show Time is an unmissable event for all adventurers of the Krosmoz and of the world of Ankama in general. Ankama Show Time is YOUR date (lucky devils!) with our teams to talk about the future, our upcoming projects, your next adventures, and to give you some amazing sneak peeks, previews and exclusive information. Ankama Show Time is therefore the ultimate stream to watch live or on demand to ensure you don't miss any Ankama news.

 

Games, Animations, Publications: the whole family together!

 

At the heart of this large family: transmedia – our band leader since the beginning, the one that makes us march to the beat of the same drum and makes our inspirations, voices and passions sing in harmony. Ankama Show Time, as you've probably guessed, is our chance to unveil the theme that will drive all our projects for the coming year.

 
It's showtime!
Wait! How about we build up some hype and give you some deets on what to expect?

 
Before
While streaming live, our content creation partners will speculate, theorize and discuss topics with you, alongside a few Ankamians… who will do their best not to crack faced with all your questions!

 
The show
The main event: A prerecorded session about 30 minutes long, during which we'll unveil (finally!) the year's theme, how it will be woven into our various projects and games, especially regarding DOFUS, WAKFU, DOFUS Touch, DOFUS Retro and Savara. This will also be an opportunity to make a big announcement regarding a certain and much-loved animated series…


 
After
Back to the livestream: Hosted by the same content creators and Ankamians, they will chat with you and recap everything that was revealed while providing more details for some topics.

 

So… All aboard the hype train?

SAVE THE DATE!

Ankama Show Time – December 18 at 6:30 p.m. CET

LIVE* on…

twitch.tv/ankamalive

Watch the REPLAY** on…

youtube.com/@ankama

 

* This stream will be hosted in French, but subtitles automatically generated by the Twitch platform will be available.

 

** The replay on YouTube will include subtitles translated by our teams in English, Spanish and Portuguese.
